name: Strata Console
description: Monitor and control your local Strata inference service.

ggufDir.title: GGUF model directory
ggufDir.description: Folder holding the GGUF shards. Local: setup.py --gguf-dir. Docker: mounted at /gguf with GGUF_DIR. Empty means the first setup downloads the model.

deployMode.title: Deploy mode
deployMode.description: local: run Strata as a local source process; docker: manage a container (Linux only). Left unset until the first run picks a default from the image list.

imageName.title: Docker image name
imageName.description: Image tag the app checks for, builds and runs

volumeName.title: Data directory (STRATA_DATA, volume or bind)
volumeName.description: Host volume or bind mounted at /data; the install config lives here

dockerStopTimeoutSec.title: Docker stop timeout (seconds)
dockerStopTimeoutSec.description: Grace period passed to docker stop/restart (-t)

dockerRunConfig.title: Docker run parameters (internal)
dockerRunConfig.description: Internal: run parameters sampled from the container for rebuilds; do not edit

cards.title: Strata Console
cards.description: Monitor and control your local Strata inference service
